title: Qatari mediators held talks in Tehran aimed at restarting direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, source says
summary_full: Axios reported that Qatari mediators held more than 12 hours of talks in Tehran on Friday to reach a deal to avoid a resumption of American-led attacks on Iran.
